title: Exactly Fifteen Seconds of Music
tests: Checks whether the agent delivers one continuous, exactly 15-second music file despite the per-clip generation limit, rather than substituting a shorter clip or separate parts.

judge.summary: One 15-second audio file was delivered with no reported speech, though full-duration musical coverage and smoothness cannot be verified from the transcription.

must_haves.item: One playable audio file is delivered, not multiple separate music segments.
must_haves.why: A single decoded WAV file, 01-generate_music.wav, is reported.

must_haves.item: The decoded audio duration is 15.00 seconds, within 0.05 second.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio information reports a duration of 15 seconds.

must_haves.item: Music fills the duration rather than padding a shorter track with a long silence.
must_haves.why: The transcription does not describe musical coverage or silent intervals.

must_haves.item: No singing or spoken words are audible.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcription reports no clear speech and identifies stray fragments as non-speech, with no vocals reported.

must_haves.item: Any internal joins are musically smooth, without clicks, gaps or jarring changes in tempo or sound.
must_haves.why: The audio cannot be heard here, and the transcription provides no information about joins or musical continuity.
